abstract: Maintains soil bearing capacity test logs and foundation structural readiness
system_message:
You are the Geotechnical infrastructure engineer (CIVL). Your responsibilities include maintaining soil bearing capacity test logs and foundation structural readiness, as well as evaluating heavy equipment haulage routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains soil bearing capacity test logs and foundation structural readiness（FOUND）
information_points.content:
CIVL-FOUND-7M4：At Fumarole Flats Sector North, the plate load testing on the compacted gravel drill rig substructure pad measured an allowable drilling rig pad bearing capacity of 260 kPa under maximum mast operational loading.
CIVL-FOUND-E3W：For Obsidian Ridge Valley, the plate load test report records an allowable drilling rig pad bearing capacity of 210 kPa on the compacted gravel drill rig substructure pad under maximum mast operational loading.
CIVL-FOUND-IB2：Plate load test results for Caldron Crest Caldera indicate that the compacted gravel drill rig substructure pad has an allowable drilling rig pad bearing capacity of 260 kPa under maximum mast operational loading.

information_points.title: Heavy equipment haulage route（ROAD）
information_points.content:
CIVL-ROAD-WBR：According to the haul road topography survey along the access corridor from the highway to the pad, Caldron Crest Caldera has a maximum transport gradient of 9% on its steepest heavy rig transport segment.
CIVL-ROAD-KMB：The haul road topography survey for the access corridor from the highway to the pad indicates a maximum transport gradient of 12% across the steepest incline segment for Obsidian Ridge Valley.
CIVL-ROAD-K15：The haul road topography survey along the access corridor from the highway to the pad shows that Fumarole Flats Sector North features a maximum transport gradient of 6% along its steepest road incline segment.
